Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research with a primary objective to project future land-use change (specifically for apple and kiwifruit horticulture) across New Zealand at a national scale. It explicitly implements spatial modeling using two contrasting climate scenarios (RCP 2.6 and RCP 8.5), produces mapped LULC projections via the LURNZ econometric model, and includes quantitative outputs such as hectares of land-use change by region and time slice. The study meets all core inclusion criteria: (1) national-scale spatial implementation (entire country of New Zealand), (2) LULC prediction is central to the research question, (3) ≥2 future scenarios are quantitatively compared, (4) spatial modeling includes quantitative metrics (e.g., area changes in ha, regional breakdowns), and (5) outputs include mapped land-use projections. It does not meet any exclusion criteria—it is not global, local, or methodological without application; it is not purely ecological or qualitative; and it goes beyond single-scenario analysis.)
